description:
Delete repository validation's parse of the event log, which exists only to count records that nothing reads.

## Background

Repository validation parses the whole event log only to count its records (`event_count`, `crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:58,86,98,175,198,319-325,355,405-413`); nothing outside the module reads the count. A malformed log therefore fails `jit validate`. Event-log integrity stays observable through `jit events`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `RepositoryValidationReport.event_count` and the event-log parse in repository validation no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test shows that repository validation succeeds over an image whose event log is unparseable.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Repository validation stops parsing the event log
